selection_type: Conditional benchmark candidates, no installed/quality winner
sources_are: Primary model cards and original repositories; license labels are not blanket rights clearance

candidates.decision: First comparison candidate; not a quality winner. Ollama qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M lists 2.5 GB; start bounded CPU context, measure RAM/latency.
Optional smaller runtime/JSON smoke candidate. Insufficient evidence for demanding Bengali editorial work.
Newer small-family comparison candidate; exact runtime/version support and Bangla quality require testing.
Current compact Gemma alternative; effective parameter count does not equal total memory. No installed compatible runtime or measured Bengali result.
Different custom terms from Gemma 4; no terms accepted or weights accessed.
12B image-generation candidate; no GPU/weights here. Not an identity-preservation or pose-control guarantee.
Multi-image edit candidate for reference experiments; untested identity preservation, large model and absent GPU.
Pose conditioning for a compatible SD1.5 pipeline; not interchangeable with FLUX. Base model, annotator and checkpoint terms must all be reviewed.

Official text/image-to-video candidate. Documented 1280x704 offload command needs at least 24 GB VRAM; not demonstrated on this CPU host or a free T4. No claimed native lip-sync or precise acting control.

Lightweight comparison candidate, checkpoint-specific custom license; lower VRAM does not prove fit. Version 0.9.8 has pose/depth-related workflows in the family but exact selected pipeline must be verified.

Bengali and emotion prompting documented; first ungated speech comparison candidate. Requires local backend/weights; Bangladeshi accent and character consistency untested. Card recommends newer Indic-Speak, which has different terms.
Bengali documented; gated information-sharing/conditions and custom code require separate review. No voice reference consent or weights obtained.
Newer model recommended by older card; custom conditions and gated access. Do not inherit the older model Apache license.
Not selected for the commercial channel pipeline under these non-commercial weight terms. Existing original procedural cues remain labeled procedural, not neural music.
Custom community license; exact usage/organization eligibility requires review before download or commercial production. No listening evaluation or local model.

candidates.license: MIT code; separate dependent model terms
candidates.decision: Official repository permits model commercial use while dependencies keep their own licenses and supplied testdata are non-commercial. No downloaded checkpoints or actual mouth-sync evaluation.
Public pretrained workflow not selected for commercial default; no commercial API used.
